title: Isometric Shooter
description: During Fall23 we worked on a isometric shooter with waves of enemies, multiple guns and BLOOM

title: Club Website
description: During the summer of 2024, we revamped our website focusing on better design. It uses Next.js with TypeScript and uses mostly Static Site Generation (SSG) from Next.js to generate all pages at build time. It also features a custom Content Management System (CMS) that automatically fetches information from organization's Notion databases to build the website.

title: Full-Stack Blog App
description: During SP24, we built a blog app using React for the front-end and MongoDB for the Back-End. It includes a main feed, pages for each author, and a page for each blog with a comment section.

title: RecipeApp
description: A cross-platform mobile application built with .NET MAUI that allows users to efficiently manage their recipes. The app features intuitive navigation for adding, editing, and organizing recipes with detailed ingredients, instructions, and images. Users can categorize recipes, filter by cuisine or dietary preferences, and generate shopping lists. The app also includes a favorites section for quick access to preferred dishes and supports cloud synchronization to ensure recipes are accessible across devices.

title: Tower Defense
description: During SP24, we worked on a tower control game developed with the Unity Engine.

title: Discord Bot
description: During AU23, we build a discord bot that scrapes steam. It can be used for various purposes, including gathering information about games, prices, reviews, and more.
